who: Small engineering teams and student developers need to verify agent-generated changes without allowing untrusted commands to run on their laptop or application server.
agent_work: The agent creates a small proof artifact, reads it back, computes a checksum, and records every proposed command before dispatching allowed work to an isolated Celesto computer.
proof_output: A guest-created proof.txt with verified contents and a SHA-256 checksum, plus an auditable run record.
